vibe_rationale: Real sneaker scene, but a trade-fair style marketplace with a bank naming partner, so the culture sits alongside commerce rather than at its core.
fit_notes: Direct precedent: Porto X launched KYRO recovery footwear at JSD 2026, so recovery and wellness products already have a place here. The myBCA naming slot is taken, leaving stall and product-drop formats, and the crowd is sneaker collectors and resellers. Indonesia-based, so an Australian brand would need a local partner.
